title: AJCC Cancer Staging Configuration
_notes: ROOT LEVEL: Defines ONE cancer type's staging rules across multiple AJCC editions and staging types (clinical vs pathological). To add a new cancer, copy this structure and fill in 'editions' with at least one edition key (e.g. '8th'). To add a new edition, add a new key under 'editions' without touching existing ones. 'applicability' lives at root (not per-edition) because histologic scope generally does not change between AJCC editions. NOTE: this schema validates STRUCTURE only. Cross-field checks (stage_groups row uniqueness, wildcard ordering, t/n/m codes referencing a defined category) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema draft-07 and are enforced separately by tests/validate_schema.py.

cancer_type.description: Human-readable cancer type name, e.g. 'Colorectal Carcinoma'.

applicability._notes: APPLICABILITY: Which histologic diagnoses this config is valid for / excluded from. Shown to the user as a confirmation step when they select this cancer type, BEFORE T/N/M selection.

histology.description: Histologic diagnosis this config is valid for, e.g. 'Adenocarcinoma'.

notes.description: Optional clarifying note, e.g. subtype specifics.

histology.description: Histologic diagnosis explicitly excluded, e.g. 'Appendiceal carcinoma'.

see_instead.description: Optional pointer to the correct cancer config file/type. May reference a file that does not exist yet in /data -- engine must handle that gracefully.

cancer_type.description: cancer_type name of the correct config, e.g. 'Appendiceal Carcinoma'.

file.description: Filename of the correct config in /data, e.g. 'appendiceal.json'.

editions.description: Keyed by AJCC edition string, e.g. '8th', '9th'. Each edition is fully self-contained (no inheritance between editions).

edition._notes: EDITION LEVEL: One AJCC manual edition for this cancer type. 'revision_date' disambiguates corrigenda/reprints within the same numbered edition (e.g. 8th edition 2017 vs. 2018 reprint corrections).

reference.description: Bibliographic citation, e.g. 'AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th Edition, Chapter 20, pp. 251-274.'

revision_date.description: Publication or corrigendum date this data reflects, e.g. '2017-12' or '2018 reprint with corrections'. Optional but recommended to disambiguate revisions within one numbered edition.

staging_type._notes: STAGING TYPE LEVEL: Independent T/N/M categories and stage groupings for 'clinical' (cTNM) or 'pathological' (pTNM). Duplicate full content even if identical to the other type. 'prefix_modifiers' documents which AJCC prefix letters (y = post-neoadjuvant, r = recurrent, a = autopsy, c/p already implied by staging_type) are expected to appear on codes in THIS block; it is documentation only, not enforced against 'code' strings yet.

prefix_modifiers.description: Optional. Which AJCC prefix modifiers apply to codes in this staging_type, e.g. ['y'] for a post-neoadjuvant ypTNM block.

stage_groups._notes: STAGE_GROUPS: Each row maps one (t, n, m) combination to a final stage. Use the exact literal 'Any' (capital A) to match all values of that category. More-specific rows must precede any wildcard row that would also match them -- checked by tests/validate_schema.py, not by this schema. Every non-'Any' t/n/m value here must also exist as a 'code' in the corresponding t_categories/n_categories/m_categories list -- also checked by tests/validate_schema.py.

t.description: T category code or the exact literal 'Any'.

n.description: N category code or the exact literal 'Any'.

m.description: M category code or the exact literal 'Any'.

stage.description: Resulting AJCC stage group, e.g. 'Stage IIIB'.

category._notes: CATEGORY: One valid T, N, or M code with its full AJCC definition text.

description.description: Full AJCC definition of this code.

reference.description: Optional override citation if this code's definition comes from a different source/page than the edition-level reference.
